params.body:
## What Shane saw

After a dealer transaction he clicked "beoordeel aankoper" and landed on a page with only the buyer's logo (Peugeot De Backer), five empty stars and a greyed "Opslaan": no title, no sentence saying whom he was rating or for which vehicle, no way back. "Klikken op beoordeel aankoper is raar."

## Which of the two it was

Reproduced in a running application with its own database. "Beoordeel aankoper" is the green button in the sold mail (`mails/sold_email`, route `ownvehicle.create.buyerVote`), so a full page is the intended delivery: a mail link has no page to open a modal on. The view renders inside `layouts.app`, but the card itself never said what it was. So it is **(b)**: the delivery was right, the content was silent. Not a broken `modal.get` and not last night's family of `href`-instead-of-`onclick` (`HandlerWiringTest` is green).

The three sister screens had the same defect in smaller measure: the seller modal on the vehicle sheet had a name but no vehicle, the bidding-winner modal said "Beoordeling koper" without a name, and the no-login page for the winner rating the dealer had no heading at all. All four carried their own copy of the same jQuery star code.

## What changed

**One shared partial** `voting/_rating.blade.php` (Alpine, no jQuery stars) for the four screens: "Voor de wagen: Peugeot 308 SW (2021)", one line on what the stars mean and that they count towards the average other dealers see for that dealer, five stars as a radio group, "Kies eerst een aantal sterren." until a star is chosen and "U geeft n van 5 sterren." after, and a save button that now visibly looks disabled (`.ui-button:disabled`, new) until a star is chosen.

**Every screen names the role and the counterparty**: "Beoordeel Peugeot De Backer als aankoper", "Beoordeel Garage Verkoper als verkoper". The page from the mail carries a page title and a back link to the own stock; the no-login page shows "Uw beoordeling van … is opgeslagen." instead of the stars once rated.

**Every save answers with a sentence** (`ui.notify`): as a flash on the list the dealer lands on (own stock or offered vehicles), as JSON for the modal on the sheet (notification, then the modal closes), as text on the no-login page. The own-stock Livewire page did not include `layouts.toast`, so every flash message to `ownvehicle.index` (including the existing "already voted") was set and never shown; it does now.

**Second rating: refused, the first stays.** The GET of each screen already refused a second rating, the four POSTs did not: a resubmitted form or a second tab wrote a second row that counted twice in the average. The store methods now check what the screens check, validate the stars (1 to 5), and answer with the sentence. The check in `addSellerVote` compared against the wrong id (the copy instead of `seller_vehicle_id`, which is what gets stored) and therefore never matched. What is stored and how it is aggregated (Inzichten, `Dealer::buyer_reviews`) is unchanged.

**A mail cannot take the modal down.** Opening the bidding-winner modal renders `VoteDealerEmail` in the same request; a vehicle without a category gave a 500 on opening the modal. Same fix as X-126: `report()`, the modal opens.

Stars are amber like the stars on the vehicle cards instead of the success green.

## Tests

`RatingScreenTest` (8 tests, 65 assertions): for each role and context the heading with the counterparty's name and the vehicle, the save with its sentence and one stored row, the second rating that adds nothing and keeps the first, the refusal of a value outside 1 to 5, and "delivered" after rating the bidding winner. Tagged `@rule S5-3.12`, `S5-3.13`, `B1-5.8`, `B1-5.11`.

`php artisan test --filter='Voting|Rating|Review|Order|Export|HandlerWiring|AlpineExpression|RulesCoverage|StylesheetSyntax|CompiledViews|Bidding|Insights'`: 114 tests, 1005 assertions, green.

## Docs

New rules R S5-3.12 and R S5-3.13 in `15-s5-kopen-bij-een-collega.md`; R B1-5.8 and R B1-5.11 in `21-b1-biedingen.md` now say what the screen shows and that a rating is given once. Finding as its own file: `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-beoordeling-zonder-titel.md` (status opgelost), including one thing seen but not fixed: `Voting::addSellerVote` guards with an assignment (`=`) instead of a comparison.

## Screens

Before: logo, five stars, greyed Opslaan, nothing else. After: title with the buyer's name and role, the vehicle, the meaning of the stars, the hint until a star is chosen, a back link; after saving the own stock list with "Uw beoordeling van Peugeot De Backer is opgeslagen."; a second click on the mail link lands on the list with "U hebt Peugeot De Backer al beoordeeld voor deze wagen. Een beoordeling wordt één keer gegeven en niet gewijzigd."
params.title: Rating a buyer opened a bare page with five stars
